name: web-video-presentation
description: Turn scripts, articles, lessons, product demos, and talks into click-driven 16:9 web presentations that can be screen-recorded as cinematic videos. Ships a Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold, a (chapter, step) cursor model, hard collaboration checkpoints, and a theme-token architecture. v1.4 adds a visual-direction layer: 8 content-driven composition primitives, hero-frame contracts before motion, 10 paper/teaching motion blueprints, an `?layout=1` debug overlay, and an `npm run layout:check` static analyzer. Opt-in paper-interpretation mode adds a concept-explanation layer (v1.5: the narrative skeleton follows the paper, but every concept is re-taught from scratch with outside intuition via an anchor -> bridge -> term -> worked-example beat, a prerequisite ledger, and an "assertion test" that fails any mechanism claim the script never justifies), a four-way evidence layer (paper fact / experiment-supported / narrator-inference / background knowledge), paper-typed narrative arcs, figure/table reuse discipline, and KaTeX formula reveals via --math.
